mechanism_explained: Seth's homework/quiz gap observation; conducting (Ask Mode → Code Mode gate) as the alternative to delegating; Codex is agentic, not chat
Bastani/Kosmyna/Anthropic empirical triplet; Frictional principle (struggle is the mechanism of learning); fluency trap; debugging gap as the most concentrated signal
Codex is superhuman at pattern completion (syntax, idiom, recall) and structurally blind to supervisory work (project, data, intent, consequence horizon); solve-verify asymmetry; dangerous middle

Technical fluency without domain depth is the danger zone; curriculum cycles (5-7 years) lag tool cycles (1-2 years); hallucination is invisible without domain depth; the discipline is the operational substitute
Ask Mode / Code Mode gate as bounded rationality (Simon) applied to AI-assisted coding; handoff conditions per step; Best-of-N as supervisory technique not feature button
Five named capacities (PA, PF, TO, IJ, EI) decompose the irreducibly human work; the capacities are structurally not closable by model improvements because the model lacks the information
AGENTS.md as the persistent project context Codex reads at every session; five-element format; 200-line operational ceiling; literate programming applied to AI collaboration
Problem formulation upstream of any Code Mode prompt; the one-sentence test on three questions; the minimum viable spec; Ask Mode interrogation as the formulation tool

The five-element specification format (task, invariants, context, output format, negative constraint) replaces requests with specs Codex cannot reasonably misinterpret; in-prompt verification dramatically improves output

Handoff conditions as specific/testable/binary checks; dangerous middle is the failure mode where the spec was clean and the output was still wrong; /rewind not forward-correct; STOP block; Best-of-N as verification

Brutalist three-file system (AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md, PROJECT.md) for creative work; Intent Layer is human always; the system says no to Codex's improvisation by design; brutalist.art is author's own (transparency)
Six-step planning sequence (ask, formulate, spec, plan, review, first prompt) front-loads the discipline; the planning gate is non-negotiable for builds over 30 minutes
Per-step loop (paste, prompt, read, verify, PA, log); three pivotal moments (handoff failure, scope creep, plausibility audit); revert after two failed corrections; in-prompt verification
Three-pass verification (functional, edge case, spec needs); post-build learning document with five sections; the artifact consolidates lessons into a form that travels to the next build
The capstone build: applying the full conducting discipline to a real project produces a step-change in supervisory capacity that reading alone does not
